page_title: CAD 2-2 SEV | Cadiz CF v Sevilla 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+6' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Cesar Soto Grado with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jesus Navas (Sevilla), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90+4' The attendance is 18886.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle after Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
90+3' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
89' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
88' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Sevilla have a free kick.
87' Roger Marti will be replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
85' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
81' Diego Alonso prepares a substitution. Mariano Diaz is replaced by Rafa Mir (Sevilla).
81' Here is a change. Marcos Acuna is going off and Diego Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla).
81' Substitution. Ivan Alejo walks off the pitch and Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) comes on as a substitute.
79' The referee shows a yellow card to Marcos Acuna (Sevilla). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
77' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge. Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
75' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
75' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
74' Sergio has decided to substitute Rominigue Kouame and he is replaced by Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz).
73' The game has come to an end for Juanlu Sanchez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jesus Navas (Sevilla).
71' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
68' The game is interrupted as Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is flagged offside.
68' The keeper makes a simple save after Roger Marti (Cadiz) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.

67' Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but Conan Ledesma is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
67' Cesar Soto Grado blows the whistle, Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) is penalised for a foul.
66' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:3.
63' Roger Marti (Cadiz) gets in a good position to shoot just outside the box after a nice pass, but his effort is unintentionally blocked by one of his teammate.
60' 2 - 2 Goal! Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top left corner. 2:2.
58' Diego Alonso has decided to make a change. Oliver Torres (Sevilla) replaces Suso.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) replaces Dodi Lukebakio.
58' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
56' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
55' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sevilla.

53' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.

52' Roger Marti (Cadiz) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
49' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
48' Great save! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Conan Ledesma.
47' Poor challenge! Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is penalised for tripping and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle.
46' The game is over for Darwin Machis (Cadiz). Ruben Sobrino comes on for the second half.
46' Sergio has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jorge Mere (Cadiz) comes on the pitch for Fali.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Pires (Cadiz) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+5' Suso (Sevilla) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+4' Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
45+4' The referee awards a corner and Suso (Sevilla) goes over to take it.

45+4' Suso (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Sevilla force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+4' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45+1' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
45' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

42' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Conan Ledesma, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
40' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the right post.
37' 2 - 1 It's in! Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the right of the goal after a cheeky lofted pass from Juanlu Sanchez. 2:1.
36' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
35' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
35' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Suso (Sevilla) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
33' The goal by Sevilla is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
32' Attention! Referee Cesar Soto Grado straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible foul in the build-up.
31' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) has a goal ruled out for offside!
31' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

30' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

28' 2 - 0 Goal! Roger Marti produces a great pass that finds Darwin Machis (Cadiz) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot past the goalkeeper and into the back of the net. 2:0.
26' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Conan Ledesma is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
26' The free kick from close range, taken by Sevilla, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' It must be a yellow card. It is. Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) receives the caution after an awful tackle.

24' Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Cesar Soto Grado no option but to blow his whistle. Sevilla win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
23' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) commits a foul and Cesar Soto Grado immediately signals a free kick.
22' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

21' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Darwin Machis (Cadiz) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cadiz CF.
21' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) commits a foul after dangerous play.
19' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
18' Roger Marti (Cadiz) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Cadiz CF win a corner.
16' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) brings his opponent down. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Fali (Cadiz) for his blatant foul.

12' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
11' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
11' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
8' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Roger Marti slips the ball through to Chris Ramos (Cadiz), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:0.
6' Roger Marti (Cadiz) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
4' Although Jose Mari (Cadiz) is just on the bench, Cesar Soto Grado has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
3' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
2' Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Sevilla will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Cesar Soto Grado will referee today's match.
